# 🎙️ The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge – Podcast Script  
**Guest:** Tracy Olson, Owner of Youthtopia Med Spa & Founder of the Aesthetic Injector Academy  
**Host:** Bethany Gifford  
**Episode Length:** 30–45 minutes  

---

### Opening  
**Bethany (Host):**  
Hi everyone, and welcome back to *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge*. I’m your host, Bethany Gifford, and this is the podcast where we dive into the real-world strategies, challenges, and stories from leaders in the aesthetics and wellness space.  

Today, I’m excited to introduce you to someone who has truly shaped the aesthetics landscape here in North Atlanta and beyond. My guest is **Tracy Olson**, the owner of **Youthtopia Med Spa** in Alpharetta, Georgia—North Atlanta’s premier destination for aesthetic excellence.  

With more than 13 years of experience, Tracy has built Youthtopia into a trusted and award-winning brand. And she’s also the founder of the **Aesthetic Injector Academy**, a fully accredited online program helping medical professionals advance their skills and earn CE credits.  

We’re going to unpack Tracy’s journey from corporate finance into aesthetics, talk about the growth of Youthtopia, dig into the importance of training and education, and explore what’s next for her business and the industry as a whole.  

Tracy, welcome to the show!  

---

### Segment 1: From Finance to Aesthetics  
**Bethany:**  
Let’s start at the beginning. You came from a corporate finance background with JP Morgan Chase—what inspired the leap into aesthetics and eventually acquiring Youthtopia back in 2013?  

*(Tracy responds with story of transition, firehose learning curve, first challenges, etc.)*  

**Bethany:**  
That sounds like such a major pivot. What were some of the biggest lessons you learned in those early years—especially as you stepped into a competitive market where Youthtopia was already one of the first med spas in the area?  

---

### Segment 2: Building Youthtopia  
**Bethany:**  
Youthtopia has become such a trusted brand in North Atlanta, winning multiple “Best Of” awards over the past decade. What do you attribute that recognition and client loyalty to?  

*(Tracy can discuss team, client care, proven devices, reputation.)*  

**Bethany:**  
I know post-COVID brought some interesting shifts in aesthetics—the “Zoom boom” and then a return to seasonality. How did your business adapt to those changes?  

*(Allow Tracy to touch on trends: GLP-1s, functional wellness, peptides, HRT, body treatments, partnerships with reps, Benchmark Study.)*  

---

### Segment 3: The Aesthetic Injector Academy (AIA)  
**Bethany:**  
Now, I’d love to talk about the Aesthetic Injector Academy. What gap in the industry did you see that motivated you to create this program?  

**Bethany:**  
For those who aren’t familiar, can you walk us through the structure of the academy and what professionals can expect to learn?  

*(Tracy can mention accreditation, curriculum: facial anatomy, safety, neurotoxins, dermal fillers, rheology, FDA-approved uses, product comparisons, CME credits.)*  

**Bethany:**  
I think it’s brilliant that you focus on online learning first—building foundational knowledge before hands-on practice. How has the response been so far from injectors and the broader aesthetics community?  

*(Tracy shares feedback, collaborations with top injectors, B2B interest, impact on students.)*  

---

### Segment 4: Industry Insights & Advice  
**Bethany:**  
The aesthetics world is growing so quickly, sometimes faster than training can keep up. What do you see as the biggest challenges for new injectors and med spa owners right now?  

*(Hiring injectors, continuing education, avoiding YouTube/Instagram misinformation, licensing issues.)*  

**Bethany:**  
On the business side, I know you pay close attention to data and KPIs. What are some of the key metrics you track to keep Youthtopia on course for growth?  

*(Tracy can mention Allergan heat maps, EBITDA, private equity landscape, client retention, etc.)*  

**Bethany:**  
If you could give one piece of advice to someone just entering aesthetics—whether as a provider or an owner—what would it be?  

---

### Segment 5: Future Plans  
**Bethany:**  
I hear you’re considering a second location. What factors go into making that decision, and how might the new space differ from your Alpharetta flagship?  

*(Tracy can share about demographics, household income, overhead, replication strategy.)*  

**Bethany:**  
At the same time, you’re also growing the academy. How do you balance expanding the spa, scaling education, and maintaining your personal life outside of business?  

---

### Closing  
**Bethany:**  
Tracy, this has been such a great conversation. You’ve shared so much wisdom—about building a trusted med spa brand, investing in education, and navigating such a fast-growing industry.  

For those listening who want to connect with you or learn more, where’s the best place to find you?  

*(Tracy mentions website: [youthtopiamedspa.com](https://youthtopiamedspa.com/) and info about AIA.)*  

**Bethany:**  
Perfect—we’ll include those links in the show notes.  

Thank you again for joining me today, Tracy. And to our listeners—thanks for tuning in to *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge*. If you enjoyed this episode, please subscribe, leave a review, and share it with someone in the industry who could benefit.  

Until next time, I’m Bethany Gifford, and this is *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge*.  

---
